title: RCSE v1.2.0 - grouped holdouts and component decision audit
description: Reproducible selective-execution study with PO-grouped and vendor-grouped holdouts, matched eight-chain safety selection, a plug-in cost policy, cluster-bootstrap component uncertainty, absolute exposure totals and contribution concentration diagnostics. Includes the full-population 210692-case study and all preceding analyses. Manuscripts, reviewer correspondence and document-editing helpers are excluded. Original code is MIT licensed; source-data attribution remains CC BY 4.0.
